description: This file defines FastAPI endpoints for the A2A protocol in the LiteLLM proxy. It includes route handlers for agent discovery, invocation via JSON-RPC, streaming responses, and external dependencies related to agents and their permissions.

methods.name: JSONResponse _jsonrpc_error( request_id: Optional[str], code: int, message: str, status_code: int = 400, )
methods.description: Creates a JSON-RPC 2.0 error response with appropriate code and message.

methods.name: _get_agent(agent_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves an agent object by ID or name from the global registry.

methods.name: StreamingResponse _handle_stream_message( api_base: Optional[str], request_id: str, params: dict, litellm_params: Optional[dict] = None, agent_id: Optional[str] = None, metadata: Optional[dict] = None, proxy_server_request: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Handles streaming messages for the A2A protocol, streaming chunks or errors back to the client.

methods.name: get_agent_card( agent_id: str, request: Request, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Handles agent discovery request, returns agent card with proxy URL if allowed.

methods.name: invoke_agent_a2a( agent_id: str, request: Request, fastapi_response: Response, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth = Depends(user_api_key_auth), )
methods.description: Main entry point for invoking an agent via JSON-RPC: handles message sending or streaming based on the method.
